newsitem.title: USA: Trico to buy 9 Wells Fargo branches.
newsitem.headline: Trico to buy 9 Wells Fargo branches.

text.p: TriCo Bancshares said its Tri Counties Bank unit reached a definitive agreement with Wells Fargo and Co to purchase nine of Wells Fargo's branches.
The sale includes deposit accounts and facilities of the branches and is subject to regulatory approval.

These branches have about $188 million in deposits. Upon completion of the purchase transaction, estimated to close in the first quarter of 1997, Tri Counties Bank will have assets totaling about $875,000,000 up from $686,000,000 today.
